name: Charlie Brown Christmas Trend: Turn Your Photo Into the Snoopy Christmas Cartoon
blurb: The Charlie Brown Christmas trend is a Snoopy AI photo: one selfie becomes a flat, hand-drawn cartoon of you in the look of the 1965 holiday special, standing on a red doghouse next to a white beagle in the snow, under a big holiday title.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Transform the person in the uploaded image into a cute cartoon character in a classic 1960s newspaper comic-strip style, with clean black outlines, soft pastel colors, simple comic-style facial features, and a cozy nostalgic newspaper-strip mood: a flat 2D cartoon like a hand-drawn animated holiday TV special from the 1960s: even black ink lines, flat solid colors with no shading, no gradients and no 3D, soft cartoon lines and a cozy retro Christmas mood. Keep the face highly recognizable, natural, and friendly. The character has a big round head, a simple cartoon face with two small black dot eyes, short-line eyebrows, a small nose, a small curved smile and small ears, a short body with short arms and legs, small rounded hands and simple shoes. It keeps everything that makes the person recognizable: the exact hairstyle, hair length and hair color, any beard or moustache, glasses (as simple bold frames), earrings and freckles, any hat, the skin tone, gender and age, and the clothes with their colors and prints, all as flat cartoon shapes. A waist-up photo gets plain trousers and simple shoes. Keep the photo's hand gesture when it fits a standing pose: a phone held up for a mirror selfie stays in the hand. No winter hat, scarf or gloves unless the photo shows them. The character stands on top of a red wooden doghouse seen straight from the front, its red sloped roof with dark plank lines and a little snow on the edges filling the bottom third of the picture, a green wreath with a red bow on the front of the roof, full body from the top of the head to the shoes, facing the camera, a little left of the middle. On the roof right next to the character, on the right, at the height of their hips, stands a small white cartoon beagle with long black ears, a round black nose and small black dot eyes, standing upright on its hind legs with a happy, proud face. Behind, in the same flat style: a snowy suburban yard, bare winter trees, a white picket fence, a small house with a snowy roof, a pale blue sky and soft falling snowflakes. At the top, in the sky: a hand-lettered holiday title in white rounded serif letters with a thin dark outline, on three centered lines: a small "A", then "Merry", then a larger "Christmas". It is the only text: spell it exactly, with no other words, signs, logos or watermark. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person and one beagle: an original cartoon of this person, not an existing cartoon character. No zigzag stripe on any shirt and no single curl of hair on the forehead unless the photo shows one. No frame, no border, no caption. The face is always the simple flat comic-strip cartoon face described above, never a photo face: the identity rules below apply to the cartoon's hair, facial hair, glasses, skin tone, gender, age and clothes.

prompts.text: A gentle, cozy holiday cartoon scene in exactly the same flat 2D comic-strip style as the image, like a hand-drawn animated holiday TV special from the 1960s: clean black outlines, flat solid colors, simple limited cartoon animation. Keep every drawing exactly as in the image: the character's face, hair, glasses and clothes, the small white beagle, the red doghouse with the wreath, the snowy yard and the title at the top. Nothing turns 3D or realistic, and the title letters stay sharp, still and spelled exactly as in the image. Soft white snowflakes drift down the whole time. The character smiles, gives a small happy wave to the camera with one hand, then sways gently from side to side as if listening to music. Next to them, the little white beagle hops happily on its hind legs, front paws up and long ears flapping, does a happy little dance on the roof, then looks up at the character and smiles. The camera stays still, with a very slow push in. Audio: a soft, gentle, original jazz piano holiday tune, light and cozy, and the hush of falling snow. No speech, no singing. No new characters, no new text, no logos, no watermark.
